later_review_audit.description: Twinkle Tray compares update content size with retained release metadata. This is a completeness check; cryptographic artifact authentication is not established by that evidence.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; release metadata authenticity, code signing, and the complete updater configuration were not established.

original_evidence.text: | Twinkle Tray | github.com/xanderfrangos/twinkle-tray | Electron | Y — custom in-app updater (`checkForUpdates`/`getLatestUpdate`/`runUpdate` in `src/electron.js`), active only for the non-packaged (non-MSIX, non-portable) NSIS/direct-installer build (`isAppX === false && !isPortable`) | Y for the check — runs automatically once per day at startup and after certain events (`checkForUpdates()` gated by `settings.checkForUpdates` and a once-per-day `lastCheck`); download+run is user-initiated via `ipcMain.on('get-update', ...)` from the renderer UI, not silent | Y — downloads the GitHub release asset directly to `%LOCALAPPDATA%...\update.exe` via `fetch(version.downloadURL)`, then `spawn(updatePath, {detached:true})` executes it and the app quits | HTTPS — release list from `https://api.github.com/repos/xanderfrangos/twinkle-tray/releases`; asset downloaded from `release.assets[0].browser_download_url` (GitHub-hosted, redirects to `objects.githubusercontent.com`), both via Node's `fetch` (default TLS validation, no pinning/overrides) | N (GitHub Releases API JSON, unsigned; no manifest signature) | none — the only integrity check is a byte-length comparison against the `size` field from the same unsigned release JSON (`if (size !== version.filesize) throw ...`); no cryptographic hash or signature of the downloaded `update.exe` is computed or checked before it is spawned and executed | n/a | src/electron.js:113 (`updatePath = path.join(configFilesDir, '\\update.exe')`); :4822-4870 (`checkForUpdates`, fetches `https://api.github.com/repos/xanderfrangos/twinkle-tray/releases`, picks `assets[0].browser_download_url`/`size`); :4873-4933 (`getLatestUpdate`, `fetch(version.downloadURL)` → `fs.createWriteStream(updatePath)`, size-only check at "Update download was incomplete"); :4937-4946 (`runUpdate`, `fileSize != expectedSize` check — size only, no hash); :4962-4970 (`spawn(updatePath, {detached:true, stdio:'ignore'})` then `app.quit()`); :3492-3495 (`ipcMain.on('get-update', ...) → getLatestUpdate(version)`, user-triggered) |
